words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round.
The buyer enters a surrogate bid of 100 on the vendor's behalf for a second QA vendor with the company uuid set to “…”.
The invited QA vendor reads the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor reads the pricing round's schema.
The invited QA vendor reads the event.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts the new bid.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the round counts the new bid.
